verdict.rationale: Usage metering with real-time accrued-cost visibility and threshold alerts is a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers invoicing, recurring invoices, a customer portal of past transactions, statements and payment reports. None of these provide current-cycle usage tracking, accrued-cost views, or pre-invoice threshold alerts.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
